conventions: Engine A. Euclidean R^4, weight e^{+S/hbar}, S = [ESW (31)] reduced from 10d (coefficient -1/4 of the Hodge pairing (F_A,F_A)), pairing <x,xi> = +int dvol (x,xi) for (A,A^*),(lambda^*,lambda),(c^*,c) [classical_spec section 3]. Q = {S_free,-}; Q^GF of DESIGN form fixed by partial_P(Q(y_a y_b)) = partial_{K_eps}(y_a y_b) (C07 Lemma 10.2.1, T=infty): P(eps,infty)(p) = e^{-eps|p|^2}|p|^{-2} x {2 (A x A, all ten directions), -i p (c x A^*|_V and A^*|_V x c), i rho(p) (lambda x lambda)} x (-,-)^{-1}. One loop: W_1 = sum_n 1/(2n) str[(P (-1)^{|.|} d2I)^n] (verified by brute force in a 0-dim super model, tadpole-free). Each internal edge t_e in [eps,infty); Gaussian loop integral exact; eps-asymptotics exact by the face (boundary) method. I^CT[eps] = Sing_eps of the one-loop 1PI graphs (I - I^CT the regularized interaction). Fourier Phi(x) = int d^4p/(2pi)^4 e^{ip.x} Phi(p). Colour: orthonormal basis of g for (-,-) in code only; c_adj = the scalar by which X -> sum_a [t_a,[t^a,X]] acts (t^a dual basis w.r.t. (-,-)); every result checked for g = su(2) and su(3) (identical rational multiples of c_adj). Units: hbar c_adj/(16 pi^2), separately for eps^{-1} and log eps. Realization: 10d chiral 16x16 gamma blocks (9 real symmetric + one i*identity in W^perp).

dilatation.route_i: Scaling map (D_lambda phi)(x) = lambda^w phi(lambda x): W(P(eps,infty),F) o D_lambda = W(P(lambda^2 eps,infty), F o D_lambda) (kernel scaling of P). Hence for O[infty]: (E-generator) O[infty] = O_{omega-dot}[infty] + 2 hbar ( [log-eps coefficient of partial_delta I^CT] + [tree insertion of the log-eps coefficient of I^CT into O] ). Assumption (A): the log-eps coefficient of I^CT is (Q+{I,-}) of the local functional 2 int(A,A^*) - 4 int(lambda^*,lambda) - int(c^*,c) [units hbar c_adj/16pi^2] (checked: unique solution at the quadratic level). Assumption (B): the Delta-component of the quantum action is corrected by 2 hbar times that functional so that the equivariant QME holds along Delta at one loop. Tree identity (verified, two-mode model): insertion of Q(Psi) into O = Q(insertion of Psi into O) - {Psi, O}. Result: gamma_O O = 2 hbar ( log-coefficient of partial_delta I^CT - {Psi,O} ). {Psi,O}: bilinear 4 O, iota_wA 2 O, A_V 2 O, lambda 4 O, c 1 O. Vertex log coefficients: traceless 4, trace -8, letters 0. Cross-check: the letter values equal the anomalous exponents of the renormalized two-point functions: from the log-eps counterterms -1 (dA,dA) and 4 (lambda, dslash lambda) the A and lambda propagators scale with extra exponents -4 and -8 (scaling dimensions 1 + gamma, 3/2 + gamma).
dilatation.route_ii: UV-boundary form: d/dlambda P(eps/lambda^2,infty) = 2 eps (Q^GF x 1) K_eps, i.e. the dilatation acts on each internal line as the special edge at t_e = eps; sum over special edges of a graph = 2 eps d/deps of the graph. Evaluated directly as face integrals (t_e = eps, other t >= eps): each face of every two-edge self-energy graph carries exactly 1/2 of its log coefficient (integrands symmetric under t1<->t2 after summing both orders), eps^{-1} faces c/8 each cancel against eps d/deps of the eps^{-1} counterterm; O-insertion triangle: each of the three faces carries 1/3, O+AAAA bubble: each face 1/2. Sum of UV-boundary graphs reproduces 2 x (log coefficients) used in route (i) exactly; with (A),(B) the same gamma follows: traceless 0, trace -24, letters iota_wA -4, lambda -8, c -2.

selection_rules: Translations, Spin(4) rotations and Spin(6)=SL(4) R-symmetry: H = Laplacian x id and Q^GF are covariant, so K_eps and P(eps,infty) are invariant; the corresponding components of (d_CE+Q)O[infty] are the classical actions, no one-loop correction; counterterms are invariant (checked: no A_V-A_perp mixing, only Spin(6)-invariant tensors in partial_delta I^CT).
Dilatation: only log-eps counterterms contribute (eps^{-1} terms are scale covariant and drop); one-loop gamma as above.

Superficial degree: 1PI with one O insertion: degree = w_O - sum of external weights; scalar bilinear: two A externals degree 0 (log), one external degree 1 vanishes by colour (f contracted with (-,-)^{-1}), lambda lambda and (A^*,c) externals negative degree.

Q^i_alpha, Qbar (weight +1/2 relative to O): output local functionals of weight w_O + 1/2, R-rep in 6 x 4 (or 4bar), chirality S_+ (S_-), ghost degree 0 coefficient: int omega (iota_w A, Gamma-contraction with lambda) [classical], and possible int omega ([c, .], lambda^*)-type terms; the Feynman-type Q^GF is not supersymmetric, so UV-boundary corrections are allowed only in these structures.

S, Sbar (weight -1/2): structures of weight w_O - 1/2 with one explicit x (from the conformal Killing field); K (weight -1): structures with x^2 / two x; ghost-degree and Lorentz/R selection as above.
Ghost number: I^CT has degree 0: quadratic sector only (A,A), (lambda,lambda), (A^*,c); (lambda^*,lambda), (c^*,c) excluded by degree.
